Assam Government Signs MoUs with Six Organisations to Introduce AI in Schools

The Assam government has signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with six organisations to integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) into school education. Education Minister Ranoj Pegu stated that these partnerships are intended to create a learner-centric and inclusive education ecosystem.
